# Flizk

> Flizk is a healthcare technology company that builds software platforms for clinics. Its product DentXOne is cloud-based dental clinic management software for dental practices in Chennai, Tamil Nadu and across India, with patient records, dental charting, appointments, billing and WhatsApp appointment reminders.

## Product

- [DentXOne](https://flizk.com/products/dentxone): Overview of the dental clinic management platform — patients, appointments, treatments, billing and WhatsApp reminders.
- [Dental clinic software in Chennai](https://flizk.com/dental-clinic-software-chennai): DentXOne for Chennai and Tamil Nadu dental clinics.
- [WhatsApp appointment reminders](https://flizk.com/whatsapp-appointment-reminders): Appointment booking and automated WhatsApp reminders to reduce no-shows.
- [Pricing](https://flizk.com/pricing): DentXOne plans; contact Flizk for a demo or a custom quote.

## Company

- [About Flizk](https://flizk.com/about): Mission, vision and story.
- [Contact](https://flizk.com/contact): Book a DentXOne demo or ask a question.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://flizk.com/privacy): How patient data is handled for WhatsApp appointment messaging, including consent, opt-out and deletion.
- [Terms of service](https://flizk.com/terms): Service terms, WhatsApp messaging, clinic responsibilities, fees and liability.
